name: rollback_last
title: rollback_last
description: Undoes the most recent checkpoint from this editor session with `git revert`, which adds a new commit rather than discarding history — uncommitted work is committed to its own checkpoint first, so nothing is ever lost. Files change on disk; scenes already open in the editor must be reopened to show the reverted version. This is what the dock's Rollback button calls.

errors.git_unavailable: The project directory is not a git work tree.
errors.no_checkpoints: No checkpoint has been recorded in this editor session.
errors.revert_failed: The revert conflicted; the working tree was left untouched and must be resolved by hand.
